appName: Happy Pee Time: VR Brain Puzzle
displayName: Happy Pee Time: VR Brain Puzzle
display_name: Happy Pee Time: VR Brain Puzzle
display_long_description:
The Ultimate Physics-Based Splash Challenge!

Get ready for the most hilarious puzzle game in Meta Horizon. Happy Pee Time: VR Brain Puzzle takes a simple concept and turns it into a series of brain-teasing, physics-based missions. Your goal is simple but the execution requires precision and a lot of imagination.

Why You Will Love It:

Creative Drawing Mechanics: Use your VR controllers to draw paths and slides in mid-air. Every line you sketch directly affects the physics and direction of the flow.

Whimsical Physics Puzzles: From moving platforms to gravity-defying obstacles, each level requires a unique strategy to reach the goal.

Hilarious and Relaxing: With its quirky theme and minimalist design, it is the perfect game to de-stress and have a good laugh while sharpening your brain.

Immersive 3D Space: Experience the fun of drawing in a full VR environment where your spatial awareness is key to winning.

Whether you are looking for a quick laugh or a satisfying physics challenge, Happy Pee Time: VR Brain Puzzle delivers a unique experience that is unlike anything else on the store. Grab your brush, aim true, and let the fun flow!
